question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Bangladesh is currently facing a serious environmental crisis due to various forms of pollution. People in urban regions are the most affected by it. In recent decades, the rapid and unchecked growth of industries has led to many environmental issues. Among them, (a) ------- pollution is a major concern, caused by emissions from factories, outdated vehicles, and dusty construction sites. To combat this, the use of cleaner fuels like CNG and LPG should be promoted, and old vehicles should be banned. Water pollution spreads fast through rivers and lakes. It is caused by littering, soil erosion, and (b) ------- of harmful chemicals into water bodies. Even dumping toxic waste near water can cause contamination. People must be careful about disposing of (c) ------- wastes and using pesticides that can wash into rivers. Soil pollution is another alarming issue. One main reason is the excessive generation of industrial waste which is not managed properly. Polythene bags and (d) ------ - chemicals also damage the soil and block drainage. Instead of using harmful fertilizers and pesticides, we should use organic options like compost. To prevent erosion and keep the soil fertile, we must practice (e) ------- by planting more trees and protecting forests. ■■■ ■■■
